name: zsazsa-report-document
description: A long CTI report imported into the zsazsa CTI program to be split into threat landscape stories

provider.description: Who published the report, such as a vendor or an agency

collection-source.description: Manual collection source the report's stories are entered under

source-reliability.description: Admiralty scale source reliability of this provider (A-F)

filename.description: File name of the PDF, attached to this event

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF, so the same file opens the same import

source-url.description: Address the PDF was downloaded from, when it was not uploaded

characters.description: Characters of text read, without running headers and footers

structure.description: What the stories were drafted from: outline, headings, size or document

import-state.description: Where the import stands: drafted, reviewed or created

stories.description: Number of stories in the manifest

manifest.description: UUID of the attachment that holds the manifest: the stories, their kind and their context

version.description: Number of the last saved change, so two analysts cannot overwrite each other
